name: @lapis-notes/desktop-electron
description: Electron desktop shell for Lapis Notes
author: Lapis Notes contributors

scripts.build: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node scripts/bundle-language-sidecar.mjs && node scripts/prepare-dist-electron.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm check:svelte && pnpm check:types && pnpm check:e2e
scripts.package:dir: pnpm build && pnpm run build:icons && CI=1 ELECTRON_BUILDER_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=true node ./scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --dir --config ./electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build && pnpm run build:icons && CI=1 ELECTRON_BUILDER_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=true node ./scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --mac --x64 --arm64 --config ./electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never && node ./scripts/write-artifact-metadata.mjs mac
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm build && pnpm run build:icons && CI=1 ELECTRON_BUILDER_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=true node ./scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --linux --x64 --config ./electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never && node ./scripts/write-artifact-metadata.mjs linux
